title: Doha SO2 drop -> LNG returns
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Doha CAMS SO2 day-over-day drop below -30 pct signals LNG train outage and leads Cheniere returns by 2 days (+); trade long LNG 5d [airquality.doha.cams_so2 -> finance.LNG.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.doha.cams_so2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long LNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
